cement-european-ng-heat-05ebf6cef3f8f1ff.rationale: The inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off European gas-heat market supplies useful heat at the plant: 54 positive one-MJ supplier references and no direct biosphere or ancillary inputs. Preserve its technology-level heat quantities without renormalization; aggregate only entries selecting the same native service. No district network, heat-delivery loss, fuel-input substitution, deallocation or additional electricity/heat credit is added. Conventional and combined-cycle large CHP use the complete native ENTSO-E gas-CHP heat-output process as an explicit European screening proxy. The 1 MWe lean-burn engine, low-NOx furnace and industrial furnace use the corresponding already reviewed native heat-output services. Technology, capacity, heat grade/pressure, allocation, source-country composition, metadata, vintage and native inventory limitations remain; score effects are unquantified. The mapped aggregate retains each native allocated inventory once per useful-heat MJ. Native allocated fuel draw is not an engineering efficiency and is not inverted or corrected. Original country distinctions and internal source parameters/uncertainty are not reconstructed. The external caller signed quantity, formula, uncertainty, separate transport and separate emissions remain unchanged. Only ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off is inspected. No other release, consequential direction, reverse route, water balance correction or inferred treatment correspondence is authorized.
